description:
Change what a segment's base visual IS: a generated still ("image"),
    fetched real media (media_source="real" — a real photo for "image", stock
    b-roll footage for "video"), or an overlay scene. Generated video is NOT
    set here — it's the state a rendered still reaches through animate_segment
    (voice=true for a Talking Head), and a "video" target without
    media_source="real" is refused with that guidance. segment_type "image"
    with carry_frame=true reverts an animated shot back to its still for free.
    media_source="real" turns the shot into fetched media with no start frame
    and no generation. carry_frame=true reuses the already-rendered image
    instead of recreating it; ignored for a real target. SFX and overlays
    always survive a type change. dry_run=true previews what would be kept /
    staled / recreated / deleted before you commit.

carry_frame.description: True reuses the already-rendered frame as the new type's starting visual instead of recreating it from scratch
carry_frame.title: Carry Frame

dry_run.description: True previews the consequences (assets kept / staled / recreated / deleted, rendered assets lost) without changing anything
dry_run.title: Dry Run

media_source.description: "" keeps the segment's current source; "real" makes the visual fetched stock footage / a real photo (b-roll) instead of a generated one; "generated" switches back
media_source.title: Media Source

project_id.description: Project ID, as returned by create_project or list_projects
project_id.title: Project Id

segment_number.description: 1-based segment number, as reported by get_segments
segment_number.title: Segment Number

segment_type.description: New visual type: "image", "video" (fetched b-roll only — requires media_source "real"), or "overlay_scene"
segment_type.title: Segment Type

name: change_segment_type
title: Change segment type
